findings.blocking: QA preflight oracle, not a T2 product finding
findings.title: Timeout case assumes the inner exchange timeout wins the original four-second owner/control deadline.
findings.actual: New timeout order holds the real peer silent, requests wall_seconds=3 and accepts only CatalogError(TASK_INDETERMINATE). The real producer can instead propagate TimeoutError after an actual write when otherwise-admitted pre-send work consumes over one second. The new test then exits before the conservative ledger/replay oracle. No PG execution was performed and this is not a claim that its current cold PG sample has already failed.
findings.producer: native_tasks.py:99-107 retains the owner deadline and normalizes RuntimeUnavailable only. local_control.py:252-281 retains its independent four-second timeout. control_task at native_tasks.py:457 has its own original four-second timeout. The first expiring outer timeout need not be the runtime RuntimeUnavailable path.

reproducer.environment: Absolute main API interpreter -I -B; cwd frozen worktree; explicit worktree api/src + api/tests + integrations/hermes/src imports. No PG env/connection. In-memory monkeypatch only.
reproducer.injection: Delegate ModelDispatch.read_configuration unchanged except await asyncio.sleep(1.25) once when its immediate caller is NativeTaskOwner._model_protocol. This is below the existing two-second DB budget, not a wider product deadline. Observe the unchanged real peer_client request list.
reproducer.control: Unmodified affected SOURCE six variants passed. A first timing control delayed a pre-protocol configuration read instead, returned normally and is retained as timeout-timing-control.json; it was not credited as the targeted reproduction.

findings.remedy: Keep T2/product limits unchanged. Make this test unambiguously exercise its intended post-write inner runtime timeout, e.g. a smaller allowed per-command wall cap for this order with matching expected caps, and observe that the intended timeout producer wins before joining. Alternatively define a separate exact outer-timeout expectation while still requiring the same post-write SENT/UNKNOWN/no-refund/replay/no-resend assertions. Do not broadly accept arbitrary failures or increase deadlines. Rerun affected SOURCE and focused review; then parent runs the single full128 PG target.
